mechanism: when the same file is appended to with echo/printf in 3 executed turns in a row (and again at 10), the harness appends one note telling the model to write the whole file in one command; no extra model turn
predicted_mechanism_change: append_turns per trial down by at least 30%; secondary: total turns down 10% to 25%
falsified_if: append_turns per trial not down by at least 30%, or total turns not down by at least 10%, or the pass-rate drop exceeds the allowed margin
why_now: 26% of dev trials write files one echo line per turn until the 100-turn cap; about 230 such trials across runs and 1 passed; no existing switch (H0 vs H2) or training (SFT/RL) reduced it
risk: one-command writes put long strings into the JSON reply, so format errors could rise
